scenes.title: 12 nights a month to gross £1,000 from a 2-bed Airbnb in Jamaica
scenes.vo: Twelve booked nights a month. That's all a typical two-bed Airbnb in Jamaica needs to gross a thousand pounds.
The typical two-bed charges about ninety pounds a night, roughly a hundred and twenty-one US dollars, across over seventeen hundred live listings.
But rates vary. Half of two-beds charge between seventy and a hundred and twenty-five pounds a night.

scenes.desc: Nights a month to gross £1,000 across the middle half of 2-bed rates (£70–£125)
scenes.vo: So depending on your rate, it's anywhere from eight to fifteen nights a month.
And that thousand is gross, before cleaning, fees and management.
Run your own numbers free with the APG Deal Analyser, in pounds, US dollars or Jamaican dollars. Link in my bio.
